title: Spartoi, the sown skeleton warriors
prompt: A monster model sheet in the blocky voxel 3D style of a Minecraft-Dungeons-like game, isometric three-quarter views on a flat parchment-cream background, every part built from chunky cubes with hand-painted pixel textures. Spartoi: skeleton warriors that grew from dragon's teeth sown in the earth, the size of a grown man. Old ivory bones with dark empty eye sockets, wearing tattered desert-tan military fatigues and boots over the bones, a dented bronze Greek helmet with a short crest, a curved bronze kopis sword in one hand and a round bronze hoplite shield in the other, painted with a black dragon-tooth emblem. Show one spartoi front, side and back; then in a ready stance behind the shield, mid-slash, and staggered back; then a squad of four marching in step, and one clawing up out of cracked earth. Menacing but readable, not gory. Palette: camp orange #f28c28, sea teal #0f6f73, deep navy #10233d, jade #2e8b6e, coral #e8664a, bronze gold #c9963a, lightning yellow #ffd84a, parchment cream #f4ead5, vase black #17130f and owl grey #8c96a3. No lettering, logos, captions or watermark.
